## What changed

Describe the user-visible problem and the chosen approach.

## Verification

List the commands or evidence used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated refactor.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests.
- [ ] Public API changes include documentation and a changelog entry.
- [ ] New benchmark claims include revision, dataset, model, and limitations.
- [ ] No credentials, private memory, raw user media, or restricted datasets are included.
- [ ] Third-party material retains its license and attribution.
